maya_cs: Sam on ACME reported SDK init causing spikes of 429s when they boot ~50 workers. Quick log excerpt:
```
POST /v1/chat 429 {"error":"rate_limited", "retry_after":0}
init worker x50
```
maya_cs: Happening ~10-25s after first requests, looks like preflight/concurrency stampede.
leo_eng: thanks — can you share app_id + sdk version? @maya_cs
maya_cs: app_id: acme-123, sdk: js@1.4.2, env: staging-us-east
raj_support: we see repeated preflight from 34.78.102.9, server logs show burst window exceeded (burst=30/s). 429s are from preflight throttle codepath.
leo_eng: probable cause: many clients doing full init in parallel instead of reusing ephemeral tokens / connections. short fixes: debounce client init, reuse token across forks, or cap concurrent preflight.
leo_eng: small suggested client knobs: set maxInitConcurrency=4, preflightDebounce=250ms, enable jitter on retries.
leo_eng: example backoff snippet:
```
const backoff = (attempt) => base * Math.pow(2, attempt) + Math.random() * jitter;
await sleep(backoff(attempt));
```
raj_support: also noticed they refresh ephemeral token every ~2s (token-ttl=2 in headers) — that churn amplifies preflight. if token refresh is tied to each worker, that'll multiply requests.
maya_cs: noted. I'll ask them to reuse a single ephemeral token for warmup and keep a refresh window >10s.
infra-bot: RateLimitPolicy alert: BurstWindow=30/s, SustainedWindow=5/s. Exceeding BurstWindow triggers short 429s; recommended client behavior: coalesce preflight, exponential backoff with jitter, reuse tokens, and limit parallel inits.
leo_eng: if they need faster ramp for onboarding tests we can temporarily raise burst allowance or provide a one-time warmup quota — I'll loop in PM for quota bump. @maya_cs
maya_cs: I'll send the playbook to Sam: 1) debounce init, 2) reuse token across workers, 3) set maxConcurrency=4, 4) exponential backoff + jitter. Will ask them to rerun and post logs here. :calendar:
raj_support: I'll tail server logs during their next attempt and report any remaining 429 patterns. :mag:
maya_cs: thanks team — will follow up after their retry. closing once they confirm fix. :thumbsup:
